svg.title: The roadmap of the website
svg.desc: The next months bring a maintained theme in place of Material for MkDocs, which reaches its end of life on May 5, 2027, a header that asks no other server, and the silver level of OpenSSF Best Practices with the levels of the OpenSSF Baseline. Later in 2027 the fonts and Mermaid, which the build downloads, get pinned hashes, or Mermaid is no longer downloaded. The website won't track its readers, run a server of its own, build the same bytes twice from live data, or seek the gold level while one person maintains it.
